PR surface: Source +17, Tests +37. Total +54 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at the source level: successful lookups for unique scoped user IDs append permanently to the current Map, so repeated unique users reproduce unbounded growth. A live current-main heap or cache-growth run was not provided.

target.title: fix(slack): bound userCache growth with pruneMapToMaxSize
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`userCache` in Slack monitor context stores resolved user names from successful `users.info` calls but had no pruning — every unique user ID accumulated forever. On a busy workspace this Map grows without bound. `channelCache` already bounds at 1024 via `pruneMapToMaxSize`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Mirror the current-main `channelCache` pattern for users: LRU touch on read, `pruneMapToMaxSize` on write, cap `SLACK_USER_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 2048`, using `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime` (not a removed helper).

## User Impact

- Long-running Slack monitors no longer retain unbounded user-name cache entries.
- Active users stay resident (LRU touch); oldest entries evict first after the cap.
- Typical workspaces under 2048 unique resolved users see no behavior change.

## Evidence

**Head SHA:** `9a27100cc39cbd2517328da533e368cb40594225` (rebased onto current `main`)

### Rank-up status

| Rank-up | Status |
|---|---|
| Rebase onto current main | done |
| Use supported `pruneMapToMaxSize` from `plugin-sdk/collection-runtime` | done (same import/path as `channelCache`) |
| Eviction regression + LRU-recency coverage | done (2 focused tests) |
| Redacted live `users.info` **success** path + bound crossing | **blocked** — see scope gap below |

### Patch shape (platinum target)

- 2 files only: `context.ts` / `context.test.ts`
- Net ~+55/−3
- No new public exports; private `readCachedUser` / `writeCachedUser` mirror `channelCache`
- Production helper on the write path (`pruneMapToMaxSize`)

### L1 unit

- `evicts the oldest user name when the bounded user cache fills` → `users.info` called 2050 times after refill of evicted key
- `keeps a recently re-resolved user while older entries are evicted` → LRU touch keeps hot user across bound insert

### Proof blocker for Overall platinum

ClawSweeper P1 requires a **successful** `users.info` OpenClaw path (populate cache, then show bound behavior). Live calls with the current tokens:

- bot `users.info` → `missing_scope` needed=`users:read`
- user `users.info` → `missing_scope` needed=`users:read`

Public-channel `conversations.members` succeeds (2 members), so channel membership proof works, but name resolution cannot succeed until the Slack app gains **`users:read`** (Bot Token Scopes) and the token is reinstalled/re-issued.

**Next contributor action:** add `users:read`, reinstall the app / refresh bot token, then re-run live resolve + Evidence update + `@clawsweeper re-review`.

- `extensions/slack/src/monitor/context.test.ts` — eviction + LRU-recency tests
